summary: Structure Developers is preparing one 260-unit conventional property in Greeley for in-house management. The calls support a lean four-user setup, a separate subsidy ledger for voucher payments, Blue Moon lease generation after screening approval, paper-check vendor payments, rentable garages and storage units, and tailored move-in, inspection, and make-ready checklists. Major product decisions include Entrata Core plus the AI bundle, full-service utility billing with vacant-cost recovery, required master-policy insurance, accounting and reporting, Facilities for mobile maintenance, Zillow/website integration, rent reporting, and pet-screening integration. Several detailed property settings still need confirmation during implementation.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / Structure Developers
callsUsed.brief: Nathan and Sabrina from Entrata, along with Jim from Structure Developers, LLC, discussed Jim's interest in transitioning his property management in-house from a third party and switching from Yardi to Entrata for his 260-unit property and two upcoming developments. Jim highlighted Yardi's integration issues and cumbersome nature, while Nathan outlined Entrata's solutions, including robust financial reporting, utility management, and resident services like rent reporting, and proposed a rapid implementation timeline with demos and a contract by month-end. The conversation concluded with plans for Nathan to schedule demos and provide pricing, aiming for a seamless transition by mid-November or early December.

callsUsed.title: Entrata Core Demo
callsUsed.brief: Nathan and Megan from Entrata, along with Jim from Structure Developers, LLC, discussed Entrata's all-in-one platform, highlighting its integrated CRM, customizable features, and AI capabilities for communication, lead management, and accounting. Jim, a former Entrata user, expressed strong interest in the system's ability to streamline operations and address current pain points with Yardi, particularly regarding real-time data, automation, and financial reporting. The conversation concluded with a discussion of pricing, implementation, and next steps, including a special offer to waive implementation fees and a proposed 36-month contract.

callsUsed.title: Accounting Demo
callsUsed.brief: Gerry, Megan and Nathan from Entrata, along with Jim from Structure Developers, LLC, discussed Entrata's accounting platform, Homebody suite of services, and utility management, with a focus on customization, efficiency, and resident-centric features. They also outlined the onboarding process, pricing for various bundles and add-ons, and a transition plan for Structure Developers, LLC to move from their current third-party manager to Entrata, aiming for implementation by the end of November. The conversation concluded with plans for a follow-up demo, a scoping call with the implementation team, and a visit from Nathan to finalize the contract.

callsUsed.title: 3rd Demo: Facilities, Work Orders and Insurance
callsUsed.brief: Cassie, Nathan and Megan from Entrata, along with Jim from Structure Developers, LLC, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management system, focusing on lease generation, integrated insurance products (renters, deposit alternative, and master policy), and the Facilities app for maintenance work orders, including AI-powered triage, vendor management, and make-ready processes. They also reviewed reporting capabilities, particularly for tracking Homebody app adoption, and scheduled a follow-up call to discuss implementation details and contract finalization.

callsUsed.brief: Nathan and Callin from Entrata, along with Jim from Structure Developers, LLC, discussed the Entrata implementation process and project timeline. Callin outlined the onboarding requirements, including merchant underwriting and data migration, while Jim confirmed his team's availability. The parties agreed to a follow-up meeting on Thursday the 22nd at 10:00 AM to finalize the project scope and timeline.
